data.body_html:
Book a Marbella photoshoot yacht for a golden hour sunset session from Puerto Banús. Our Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) starts at €749 for 2 hours – all-inclusive with skipper, drinks, and snacks. No hidden fees, no surprises.

Why a photoshoot yacht in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers 27 km of Mediterranean views, with La Concha mountain as a backdrop. A private yacht from Puerto Banús gives you exclusive access to the best angles – from the marina’s superyacht-lined docks to the open sea at Cabopino. Golden hour light here is consistently warm from May to September, with temperatures averaging 28°C. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are perfect for influencer shoots, couple portraits, or small brand campaigns.

Our recommended boats for photoshoots

We operate a fleet of 18 yachts from Puerto Banús. For golden hour shoots, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) offer the best value at €749/2h. Both include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. For larger groups or a jet ski prop, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours (jet ski included). All other boats – including the Ferretti 94 (29m) and Maiora 26m – are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Golden hour timing in Marbella

Sunset times vary by season:

  • May–August: 20:30–21:30 (golden hour 19:30–21:00)
  • September–October: 19:30–20:30 (golden hour 18:30–20:00)
  • November–February: 17:30–18:30 (golden hour 16:30–18:00)

We recommend a 2-hour charter starting 30 minutes before sunset. This gives you enough time to shoot from the dock, the bow, and the flybridge as the light changes.

What’s included in your charter

Every photoshoot yacht charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full duration
  • Bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT) – no extra taxes

You can bring your own photographer, drone (subject to local regulations), and props. The skipper will position the yacht for the best light.

Sample itinerary: 2-hour sunset shoot

19:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board the Astondoa 40.
19:15 – Depart marina, head west towards Cala del Faro.
19:30 – Golden hour begins. Shoot on bow, flybridge, and stern.
20:15 – Anchor near Cala Cortés for water-level shots.
20:45 – Return to Puerto Banús as the sun sets behind La Concha.
21:00 – Disembark.

This route covers 5 NM of coastline with uninterrupted views. For longer shoots, the 8-hour option (€2,299) lets you explore Estepona or Sotogrande.

Booking & pricing

Book directly via WhatsApp for instant confirmation. Tier A pricing is fixed: €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, pricing starts at €4,719 for 4 hours (jet ski included). All other boats are on request. We do not use third-party platforms – you deal directly with the operator.
